CFB-week.summary: Several lead playmakers are out: Miami WR Malachi Toney (ankle surgery), Indiana RB Turbo Richard, Ole Miss RB Kewan Lacy and UCF RB Duke Watson. Covers quotes Tennessee's passing line for George MacIntyre while the packet lists Faizon Brandon as the starter, so Tennessee's QB should be confirmed. Most college prop boards were thin two days out; FOX's odds tabs do not name the book.

NBA-ATL-at-CHI-1114.summary: Both starting guards are questionable: Chicago's Norman Powell (shoulder, two straight missed games) and Atlanta's Kingston Flemings (back). If Flemings sits, CJ McCollum likely returns to the Hawks' starting lineup; Chicago is also without Caleb Wilson for weeks.

NBA-CLE-at-MIA-1114.summary: Giannis is probable with the right wrist sprain he has played through since early November (40+ minutes on Nov 4). Cleveland is without Sam Merrill; Klay Thompson and Pelle Larsson are questionable for Miami. No minutes limit reported for Giannis.

NBA-GS-at-SA-1114.summary: Golden State is without Stephen Curry (oblique tear diagnosed Nov 12, re-evaluated in two weeks) and Brandon Williams (hamstring, at least a week), plus Porzingis, Butler and Moody; Bassey is expected to play. San Antonio lists Vassell and Fox as questionable and Tobias Harris out.

NBA-MEM-at-NO-1114.summary: New Orleans is thin on the wing: Trey Murphy (knee) and Bennedict Mathurin (thumb) are both doubtful and Watford is out, which leaves more shots for Zion Williamson and Dejounte Murray, with Saddiq Bey, Jordan Poole and Karlo Matkovic absorbing minutes. Memphis is without centers Zach Edey and Quinten Post.

NBA-NY-at-IND-1114.summary: The Knicks list no injuries for Friday in Indiana. The Pacers remain without Haliburton (hamstring), Sheppard and Furphy, and starting wing Aaron Nesmith is questionable after leaving Wednesday's game with a sore right knee. Indiana's preview lists Landry Shamet, not Josh Hart, among the Knicks' probable starters.

NBA-OKC-at-LAC-1114.summary: Ajay Mitchell (ankle) is questionable for OKC after missing Wednesday, when Alex Caruso started in his place; Jaylin Williams (back) is out again, so Aday Mara keeps starting next to Isaiah Hartenstein. The Clippers are without Brandon Ingram, Bradley Beal and Niederhauser.

NBA-POR-at-SAC-1114.summary: Portland is without Ja Morant, Vit Krejci and Shaedon Sharpe, with Chris Youngblood listed out on the app report but day-to-day on another injury feed. Sacramento is without Maxime Raynaud and Ben Simmons, with Precious Achiuwa questionable (ankle). No news found that changes the targets' roles.

NBA-UTAH-at-HOU-1114.summary: Utah is missing Markkanen (hand, a month+), Jaren Jackson Jr. and Nurkic, so Josh Green starts and Keyonte George (back from an ankle sprain) carries the scoring. Houston opens Marcus Smart's three-game suspension and is still without centers Capela and Adams.

NFL-CAR-at-NO-1115.summary: Both teams' main backs got rest days Wednesday and practiced fully Thursday (Hubbard, Kamara). Travis Etienne Jr. (hamstring) is practicing off New Orleans' IR, which could crowd the Saints' backfield, while CJ Donaldson and center Erik McCoy have missed both practices. Noah Fant was upgraded to full participation (back), and Carolina's Jonathon Brooks practiced fully.

NFL-HOU-at-CLE-1115.summary: Cleveland WR1 Denzel Boston (toe) missed Wednesday and Thursday and TE Harold Fannin is limited, clouding Watson's passing game. Houston's backfield is unsettled: Woody Marks (knee) slipped to DNP Thursday while David Montgomery (groin) returned limited; Marvin Harrison Jr. (hamstring) also went DNP Thursday.

NFL-JAX-at-TEN-1115.summary: Jacksonville RB Bhayshul Tuten (ankle/foot) missed Wednesday and Thursday practice, with Chris Rodriguez Jr. limited (hand); Jakobi Meyers went from no practice to limited. Titans WR1 Carnell Tate (shoulder) missed Wednesday and Thursday, and Tony Pollard was full Wednesday before a Thursday finger/rest day off.

NFL-LA-at-ARI-1115.summary: The Rams put Puka Nacua (knee MCL/toe) on IR Thursday, with Davante Adams already on IR, so Tutu Atwell and Konata Mumpfield lead a thin receiver room; all three Rams tight ends are on the report. Arizona starts rookie Carson Beck in his NFL debut after Gardner Minshew's season-ending injury, with Michael Wilson also out for the season, which leaves Trey McBride as the main target.

NFL-MIA-at-IND-1115.summary: Indianapolis traded Keenan Allen and Josh Downs before the deadline, leaving Laquon Treadwell, Anthony Gould and Ashton Dulin atop the Week 10 receiver depth chart. Miami WR Chris Bell (knee) was not seen at Thursday practice. Indoor game.

NFL-MIN-at-GB-1115.summary: Minnesota traded for Kirk Cousins on Tuesday. He took first-team reps and is reported to be on track to start, though O'Connell had not formally named him by Wednesday; Kyler Murray (hamstring) did not practice and Wentz was limited. Hockenson and Jauan Jennings missed both Wednesday and Thursday practices. For Green Bay, Josh Jacobs is out after finger surgery, MarShawn Lloyd is off the injury report, and Chris Brooks is close to returning from IR.

NFL-NE-at-DET-1115.summary: Goff (chest) practiced fully Thursday, but Amon-Ra St. Brown was limited all week with a rib injury. New England has TreVeyon Henderson out, Rhamondre Stevenson (knee) only limited, and A.J. Brown (ankle/knee) back at limited practice, possibly for his first game in weeks; both secondaries are short (Davis out for NE, Reed and Joseph out for DET).

NFL-SF-at-DAL-1115.summary: Dallas loses TE Jake Ferguson and RB Tyler Goodson for weeks, funneling targets to CeeDee Lamb, while staff say they must manage Javonte Williams' carries. San Francisco likely plays without Mike Evans again but gets Deebo Samuel back at limited practice; both teams have banged-up secondaries.

SOCCER-day.summary: No confirmed injuries or suspensions among the listed players. Reijnders was benched for Guus Til at Greece in October, and Gabriel Pereira's recent Vasco starts came while Saldivia was suspended for the cup. Uruguay's November squad (Nunez, Vinas) could not be confirmed.

NBA-DET-at-WSH-1113.summary: Second meeting this week after Monday's game in Detroit. Detroit stays without Jalen Duren (hamstring, re-evaluation about two weeks out) and Isaiah Joe (hip), so John Collins keeps starting at center. Washington is missing Vukcevic, Beekman, Champagnie and Jamir Watkins. Detroit is a 10.5-point road favorite with a 220.5 total, so a lopsided game could cut starters' fourth-quarter minutes.

NFL-WAS-at-NYG-1113.summary: Final reports confirm Cam Skattebo (hamstring) and J.J. McCarthy (hip) have no game designations after full practices, so Skattebo returns as the Giants' lead back and Singletary moves back to a reserve role; LB Malik Harrison is the only Giant listed (questionable), and CB Colton Hood (finger) finished full. Washington is out G/C Lucas Patrick and TE Colson Yankoff, with Daniels full all week, Burks expected to play, and McLaurin still on IR (Croskey-Merritt's IR status was not re-checked today). The total has slid from 42.5 to 40.5 with rain and gusty wind forecast.
